messages:
Maria Support: heads up — Acme reported a sharp p99 increase after we flipped lancer-extended-v2 to canary. p95 looks OK (~200ms) but p99 spiking to ~4.6s since ~03:10 UTC. UI timeouts for them.
Cheng ML: :thinking_face: what percentage did we send to the v2 canary?
Sam Runtime: Canary was at 12% auto-rollout. Alert fired 03:14. I pulled traces — tokenization stage + kernel selection blocking on first token are the primary tail contributors.
Maria Support: Customer asks for an immediate workaround or rollback. Can we route them to the previous variant?
oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2026-0518. Severity: high. Pager notified.
Nash Infra: We can add a per-org routing rule to pin them to lancer-extended-v1-compat quickly.
Sam Runtime: Doing the route change now. Pushing rule... update: 90% traffic moved to v1-compat for org acme_corp. Observed p99 drop from 4.6s -> ~700ms within 90s.
Customer JD: Confirmed. Latency back to expected except occasional spikes ~1.1s on very long inputs (>12k chars). Thanks for the quick switch.
Cheng ML: I repro'd the tail in staging using a long-context workload (seq_len ~3000). Metrics: model=lancer-extended-v2, p95=210ms, p99≈4600ms, tokenize_time_99≈1100ms, kernel_select_99≈2500ms, kv_cache_miss_rate high.
Cheng ML: Root cause: v2's tokenizer bundle added an NFKC normalizer that falls back to a python regex path for certain unicode sequences we see in customer logs — that fallback is single-threaded and costly on long docs.
Harper Eng: Also the runtime performs a synchronous kernel probe for quantized kernels when seq_len > 2048 and batch_size=1. That probe can add 200-800ms on warm requests. Two orthogonal tail contributors.
Nash Infra: Short-term mitigations?
Sam Runtime: 1) Pin affected orgs to v1-compat (done). 2) Route v2 traffic through our warm pool (keep-warm) to avoid kernel probe pay on cold nodes. 3) Runtime flag to skip the quantized kernel probe as opt-out while we patch tokenizer.
Maria Support: What can we tell customers who want a quick client-side workaround?
Cheng ML: Options: a) pre-tokenize client-side and send token ids if they can. b) add a client-side truncation to keep initial seq < 2000. c) pass the request with header "Use-Fast-Tokenizer: true" — note: only supported on v2 builds with the fast tokenizer bundle. Example reproduce curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"lancer-extended-v2","input":"<very long text>","max_tokens":512}'
```
Sam Runtime: I added a runtime opt-out flag (probe_skip=true) to a small control pool; will need restart for full rollout. ETA: stage in ~2h, full in ~5h.
Harper Eng: Opening urgent PR to revert the NFKC change in tokenizer bundle and replace with a fast C++ normalizer. PR ETA: 3-5h, rebuild + canary ~8-12h. Adding unit tests for the unicode edgecases.
Cheng ML: For immediate internal repro run: 
```
python perf/load_driver.py --model lancer-extended-v2 --seq-len 3000 --batch 1 --rate 5 --duration 600
# traces -> /tmp/traces/*.json
```
Sam Runtime: I attached representative traces to INC-2026-0518 (trace ids: t-88a, t-88b). Key trace spans: tokenize >1s and kernel_select blocking wait.
Maria Support: I've told the customer: pinned to v1-compat, suggested truncation or pre-tokenization, and promised ETA for permanent fix. They requested a postmortem for compliance — we'll produce one.
Cheng ML: Plan summary: immediate = per-org pinning (done) + warm-pool routing + runtime probe opt-out. Mid-term = revert tokenizer change + fast normalizer + publish v2 variant with tokenizer v1 compatibility. Long-term = automated long-context perf tests in CI and docs for client-side pre-tokenization.
Nash Infra: I'll schedule the runtime opt-out rollout during the next maintenance window and coordinate with oncall.
Customer JD: Please notify us when v2 is safe to re-enable for our org. We need confirmation before switching back.
Maria Support: Will follow up. Tracking tasks: RT-2314 (route rule + warm pool + opt-out), TK-5021 (tokenizer revert), linked to INC-2026-0518. Will post updates here as PRs land. :thumbsup:
